a: The basics: slightly fewer calories than you burn, plenty of protein and vegetables, regular walking and strength training, and good sleep. Check with a doctor for personal plans.
Lift weights 3 to 4 days a week using compound moves like squats, push-ups or presses and rows. Eat enough protein, sleep 7 to 9 hours, and increase difficulty gradually.
Keep a fixed sleep schedule, no screens 30 to 60 minutes before bed, a cool dark room, and no caffeine late in the day.

q: how much water should i drink
a: About 2 to 3 liters of total fluids a day for most adults, more if you are active or it is hot.

Join something you enjoy like a club, gym class or online community, show up regularly, ask questions, and follow up. Friendships come from repeated contact.
Be curious and relaxed, ask real questions, listen more than you talk, and be yourself. Confidence comes from practice, not from a perfect line.
